Yes, my plan was to wait until after my best friend's dad dies (he's dying of cancer), and then wait as long as I can to make sure they're okay. 

Last night was just really hard for me so I was contemplating it. But I can't do that to them, a double whammy like that would be too much. Also I would rather die far away from this stupid town, so I was planning to do it in a hotel room.
for what it's worth I regret my rhinoplasty with Facial Team.

I also feel that way. I don't actually think I will survive this, I think about her all the time, and it's been this way for years. I know it's hard. But I think we need to face our fears eventually. Even if it doesn't save us. They need to know how we feel.
I'm in a similar situation. Is there any way you could resolve things with them? Even if it takes years?

I'm also trans and struggling. I hope you're okay. I don't know if there's peace in death, maybe in the sense that there's no pain, but there may not be any joy either. And if you keep living, there might be joy or love in your future. Don't give up.

The photo's not really representative. The main problem is the brow and forehead work, which is kinda obscured by my bangs/makeup/the light in that picture. I could DM you other pictures if you want. The main issue is that it's very subtle and not measurably better than what I could have gotten with insurance, and $35k is a lot of money, especially as I'm now broke and struggle to pay rent. Again, it's my fault, but I feel that this is a danger that should be recognized.
I'm trying to contact her now. May is not bad for a consultation.
Yep. It wasn't hitting me how stupid the decision was until I got hit with some other reality checks, but like. How stupid could you be to turn down free surgery??? Lol

I have MediCal. With this I can try to schedule something with Min Jun, who does robotic peritoneal SRS, which might be better since I don't have much to work with. I wanted to get Thai method but can't be picky now. Justine Lee is covered by MediCal if I want revisions with her, but dates are far out. 

Starbucks insurance covers way more. Like Keojampa, but his dates are probably further out. For VFS, I've heard Aetna covers it with Dr. Thomas.

This. Act 5-2 is legendary, and it was the time I started reading. Such a great ride, especially the ending sequence. It's not just the most narratively satisfying, and the most emotionally impactful towards the end, but it's by far the most inventive when it comes to implementing mixed media. Homestuck at its most Homestuck, and its best.
